name: Archery
description: Unlocks crafting recurve bows from leather.

name: Fortifications
description: Unlocks sandbags for cover and embrasures to shoot through.

name: Hearths
description: Unlocks the stone hearth, a much stronger heater than a campfire.

name: Insulation
description: Rooms lose heat half as fast.

name: Comfortable bedding
description: Unlocks the fine bed: prettier, and colonists rest 25% faster in it.

name: Crop rotation
description: Crops grow 25% faster.

name: Field medicine
description: Doctors tend wounds and illness noticeably better.

name: Electricity
description: Unlocks the wood-fired generator and the electric heater.

name: Solar power
description: Unlocks solar panels and batteries.

name: Refrigeration
description: Unlocks iceboxes, freezer units and air conditioners.

name: Sun lamps
description: Unlocks sun lamps: crops beneath them grow day and night, all year.

name: Tailoring
description: Unlocks tailoring tunics from cloth and warm parkas from leather.

name: Longbows
description: Unlocks the longbow: the longest reach of any bow.

name: Crossbows
description: Unlocks the crossbow: slow to load, but its bolts punch through armor.

name: Armor
description: Unlocks leather armor, which turns aside a quarter of every blow.

name: Scale armor
description: Unlocks scale armor of granite plates: heavy, but stops nearly half of every blow.

name: Traps
description: Unlocks spike traps that wound the first raider to step on them.

name: Optics
description: Unlocks the telescope: stargazing on clear nights, outdoors.

name: Fine arts
description: Unlocks the grand sculpture: granite and silver, the finest piece a colony can make.

name: Instruments
description: Unlocks the harp, the finest instrument a colony can make.

name: Signal beacon
description: Unlocks the signal beacon: transmit for five days and a ship may answer.

name: Milling
description: Unlocks the millstone, to grind grain into flour, and baking bread that keeps for a month.

name: Pottery
description: Unlocks the kiln, to fire clay from the riverbanks into bricks, and brick walls and floors.

name: Smelting
description: Unlocks the smelter, to turn iron ore into iron for tool kits, swords and mail.

name: Deep mining
description: Unlocks the mine shaft: miners dig down for stone, iron ore and silver, richer the deeper they go. Dig deep enough and something may dig back.

name: Masonry
description: Builders know their trade: all construction goes a fifth faster.

name: Irrigation
description: Channels and ditches: every harvest brings in a quarter more.

name: Preserving
description: Salting, smoking and sealing: food spoils a third slower.

name: Animal husbandry
description: Taming comes easier, and tame animals breed twice as often.

name: Herbalism
description: Clean dressings and poultices: wounds turn infected less than half as often.

name: Engineering
description: Better boilers: generators burn a third less wood.

name: Prospecting
description: Miners follow the richest seams: mine shafts bring up a third more ore.

name: Civics
description: A village that knows how to govern itself: being well led lifts everyone twice as much.

name: Tactics
description: Drill and discipline: colonists shoot straighter in a fight.

name: Surgery
description: Iron instruments and a steady hand: bad wounds are half as likely to leave a lasting mark.
